name: Ballad Flutes
description: 00 8400 000: two soft flutes with a gentle V2 vibrato and no click, under a singer.

name: Ballad Jazz
description: 88 8000 000 with the third's percussion soft and slow, the V3 vibrato and the click down: a late-night jazz ballad's chords.

name: Bell Percussion
description: 00 0400 000 with the third's percussion normal and slow: little bells struck over a quiet 4' at each chord.

name: Blues Shuffle
description: 88 8000 008: the 16', 5 1/3' and 8' with a whistle of the 1' on top, the drive breaking up, the C3 chorus: a shuffle's organ.

name: Cathedral
description: 88 8888 888 on the upper and 88 8888 000 below, the pedals full, no scanner and the drive clean: every pipe-like wheel at once.

name: Clarinet
description: 00 8080 800: the 8', 2 2/3' and 1 3/5', the odd harmonics alone, with the V2 vibrato: a hollow, clarinet-like voice for chords or a solo line.

name: Full Gospel
description: Every drawbar out, no percussion, the C3 chorus and the drive up a little: the whole organ for a choir.

name: Funk Stabs
description: 88 8000 000, the third's percussion normal and fast, no scanner, the drive and the click up: short, biting funk chords.

name: Garage Combo
description: 00 8888 000 with the V1 vibrato, no percussion and some drive: thin, bright and reedy, a sixties garage band's organ.

name: Gospel Shout
description: 88 8800 888 with the C3 chorus and the drive pushed: the shout chorus of a gospel band, the top drawbars screaming.

name: Hymn Principal
description: 68 8644 220 with no scanner, no click and the leakage low: a plain, steady principal chorus for a hymn.

name: Init
description: The classic first registration, 88 8000 000, with the third harmonic's percussion, soft and fast, and the C3 chorus.

name: Jazz Trio
description: 83 8000 000 with the third's percussion, normal and fast: the walking-line jazz sound, the C3 chorus on.

name: Lo-Fi Worn
description: 00 8800 000 with the leakage and the click high and the expression low: a tired organ that hums and clicks in the back of a beat.

name: Pedal Bass
description: The pedals' 16' and 8' under C3, the lower manual's 00 8600 000 above it with the C3 chorus: the left hand and feet of an organ trio, a bass line under chords.

name: Prog Lead
description: 88 8888 888 into a preamp driven almost flat out, the click and the leakage up: a screaming, distorted organ for a solo.

name: Reggae Bubble
description: 00 8600 000, the second's percussion soft and fast and the drive low: the short, hiccuping offbeat chords of a reggae band.

name: Rock Drive
description: 88 8800 000 with the preamp pushed hard and the click up: the growl of a rock band's organ into a rotary.

name: Second Percussion
description: 80 0000 000 with the second harmonic's percussion, normal and slow: the 16' under a ringing octave.

name: Soul Comping
description: 68 8600 000 with the third's percussion and the C2 chorus: a warm soul organ that sits under a horn section.

name: Split Bass
description: The upper's 88 8000 000 over the lower manual's 00 8800 000 below C4, and the pedals' 16' and 8', as a player's two hands.

name: Sunday Pad
description: 00 8800 000 on the upper and the C1 chorus, the expression pulled back a little: the soft pad under a preacher.

name: Swell Strings
description: 00 6876 543: the drawbars sloping away above the 8', the C3 chorus on both manuals: a soft string-like pad.

name: Theatre Tibia
description: 80 8008 008 with the deepest vibrato: the wobbling, singing flutes of a cinema organ.

name: Twelve Bar Whistle
description: 80 0000 008: the 16' and the 1' alone, no percussion (it would take the 1'), the C3 chorus: hollow, high and whistling over a low hum.
